STATE OF MISSOURI

WARREN E. HEARNES

JEFFERSON CITY, MISSOURI 65101
May 10, 1972
Mr. Yates M. Barber, Jr.
Acting Chief, Office of Environmental Quality
USDA Fish and Wildlife Service
Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife
Washington, D.C. 20240
In Re: Draft Environmental Impact Statement
• for proposed "Endangered Species
Conservation Act of 1972". DOCA
72040022
Dear Mr. Barber:
The draft Environmental Impact Statement for the above proposal has been reviewed by the State Clearing-house in accordance with Office of Management and Budget Circular A-95 (Revised) and Section 102(2) (c) of the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969.
The attached comments were received in regard to this proposal.
No other state agency reviewing this proposal had comments to offer and further review is not required by the State Clearinghouse.
Sincerely,
Terry L. Rehma State Clearinghouse Coordinator
TID Jont
